resources.use: Higher-capacity multilingual/local retrieval option for the primary host

resources.use: Offline code drafting, unit-test suggestions, code repair and analysis under supervision

resources.use: CPU-only, ONNX-quantized local reranking of up to 12 retrieved document passages
resources.risk_notes: Installed pinned ONNX model verified by SHA-256 and Git blobs; only on Ubuntu, optional, 256-token context, not validated on Dell. No automatic executables.

resources.use: Potential English speech-to-text backend once Ubuntu voice permissions and audio tests are in place
resources.risk_notes: Downloaded checkpoints are not active. Prefer safe tensor/quantized formats; don't assume existing app microphone access.

resources.use: Offline, CPU-int8 English speech transcription from selected WAV files; PipeWire microphone only when explicitly activated
resources.risk_notes: CTranslate2 conversion of Whisper Tiny English. One licensed 3.5-second speech sample transcribed successfully; microphone capture not physically tested. No automatic recording.

resources.use: Optional fallback for very low RAM or fast, low-complexity requests
